        (ConnectorDefinition) of named operations — each itself a reusable WeaveDefinition — plus a

        dotted user-defined actions (connector.op) and dispatched through the existing userDefinedAction

        exposes the active connection to templates as {{ connection['...'] }} with secrets auto-redacted.

com.weavric:weavric-connectors-api 2.1.0 发布, Connector packaging/install API for Weavric (#148). Parses a connector
        manifest (YAML or JSON) into a ConnectorDefinition, runs a compatibility check
        (requires.engine / requires.modules) and installs it through the connectors SDK's
        ConnectorInstaller, exposing thin admin endpoints under /admin/connectors. As a LIBRARY this
        module does NOT impose a SecurityFilterChain; instead it provides a ConnectorAdminRequestMatcher
        that the consuming app wires into its own chain and MUST guard with an admin authority.
        Connector installs are app-wide (operations register into the global definition source);
        per-tenant connector registration is deferred to the scope phase.

items.title:
com.rapiddweller:rapiddweller-benerator-ce 4.0.0-jdk-11 发布, rapiddweller 'Benerator' is a software solution to
        generate, anonymize, pseudonymize and migrate data for
        development, testing and training purposes.

        rapiddweller 'Benerator' is easy to learn, integrates into CI Tools like Jenkins and Gitlab CI
        and allows to create data models on the most abstract level.

        rapiddweller 'Benerator' allows creating realistic and valid high-volume test data, used for
        testing (unit/integration/load) and showcase setup.
        Metadata constraints are imported from systems and/or configuration files. Data can imported from
        and exported to files and systems, anonymized or generated from scratch. Domain packages provide
        reusable generators for creating domain-specific data as names and addresses internationalizable
        in language and region. It is strongly customizable with plugins and configuration options.

        rapiddweller 'Benerator' is build for Java 1.8 and Java 11. The development is ongoing for Java 11.
